implementation: Arxan Cryptographic Key & Data Protection TDES Component
description: Arxan Cryptographic Key & Data Protection, a state-of-the-art Whitebox Cryptography, transforms crypto keys and data so neither can be discovered while at rest or at runtime. It supports Triple-DES algorithm in whitebox form to protect sensitive keys and data in hostile or untrusted operational environments.
